Subject: Candidate ready - Priyanka Shah (SDE2) paymix + docs

Hi Karthik / team,

Priyanka completed the final loop yesterday and is enthusiastic about Redwood. Attaching a draft offer and a compact comp summary with the proposed paymix. Key ask: were looking to convert an existing contractor headcount into this full-time slot; candidate is aiming for a 10/7 start. Summary:
- Role: SDE2, Platform (reporting to Miguel Rivera)
- Proposed base: $150,000
- Target cash bonus: 12% of base (annual)
- Equity: $80,000 target grant (value), recruiter proposed 3-year vest schedule in draft
- One-time sign-on: $7,500 (requested by candidate, negotiable)
- Relocation stipend: $5,000 (if needed)

Please confirm: (1) comp band alignment for US-West SDE2, (2) whether we must default to Redwoods standard 4y/25% schedule for equity, and (3) headcount conversion approval so we can send the offer via DocuSign.

Attachments: Priyanka_Shah_Offer_DRAFT.pdf (draft offer), comp_summary_Q3_2029.csv

Thanks,
Elaine

Subject: Re: Candidate ready - Priyanka Shah (SDE2) paymix + docs

Marissa / Laura / Michael,

Quick review of the materials attached. Two immediate policy flags:
1) Draft uses a 3-year vesting cadence for the RSU; our standard is 4y with 25% at 12 months. Im fine with keeping $80k the target but will prefer standard vesting unless CompOps advises otherwise.
2) Candidate asked for a $7.5k sign-on. Is that within hiring discretionary budget for SDE2 conversions? If so Id like a small discretionary sign-on to help close.

Michael  can Finance confirm we can convert the open contractor slot to FTE and absorb the one-time sign-on within the current quarter? If yes I will approve the offer to be issued with a 72-hour acceptance window.

Karthik
Director, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-08-22T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate ready - Priyanka Shah (SDE2) paymix + docs

Karthik / team,

I ran the comp numbers and policy checks. Notes below:
- Base $150k + 12% bonus = $168k cash on target.
- Equity: keep $80k target value; switch to Redwood standard vesting (4y, 25% cliff). That keeps grant value identical but spreads realized RSU over 4 years for accounting.
- Sign-on: $7.5k one-time is within manager discretionary threshold for this level, but requires Finance approval to confirm budget routing. We can treat it as a lump sum in the first payroll (coded as sign-on).
- Relocation: $5k is fine under our small relocation stipend policy; confirm candidate needs it before including.

I updated the draft offer language to reflect 4y vesting and added a clause for a one-time sign-on if Finance signs off. I attached the updated offer to the approvals queue (headcount_change_FIN-REQ-5297.pdf) for visibility.

I can stamp CompOps approval once Finance confirms the sign-on and headcount routing.

-Marissa
Compensation Operations
Redwood Inference
